# Official Qt WebP image plugin

This is the unmodified release x64 `qwebp.dll` from Qt Image Formats 6.12.0,
matching Prism's Qt version and MSVC toolchain. It is deployed app-locally;
the installed Qt environment is unchanged.

Package: https://download.qt.io/online/qtsdkrepository/windows_x86/desktop/qt6_6120/qt6_6120_msvc2022_64/qt.qt6.6120.addons.qtimageformats.win64_msvc2022_64/6.12.0-0-202609280346qtimageformats-Windows-Windows_11_24H2-MSVC2022-Windows-Windows_11_24H2-X86_64.7z

The official archive's published SHA-1 was verified before extraction. Only
`plugins/imageformats/qwebp.dll` is used. Matching source:
https://github.com/qt/qtimageformats/tree/v6.12.0

Qt's LGPL-3.0/GPL-3.0 license texts and bundled libwebp's BSD license are included
alongside this notice. This dynamic plugin remains replaceable. Distribution
must satisfy Qt's existing licensing requirements; the complete matching source
is available from the link above. libwebp copyright and terms are in `COPYING`.
